name: ez barbell anti gravity press
description: A chest-supported EZ-bar press on an incline bench. Press the bar forward and upward in line with the bench rather than standing to push it vertically overhead.
instructions: Set an incline bench and lie chest down against it with your feet planted behind you.
Hold a light EZ bar near the front of your shoulders with a comfortable grip.
Brace your trunk against the bench and press the bar forward and upward along the angle of your torso.
Extend your arms without shrugging, then lower the bar slowly to the start.
